definitions.gloss: contrail; vapor trail (left by an aircraft)
definitions.explanation: The white trail of condensed water vapor that forms behind a high-flying aircraft. Literally {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane) + {雲|くも} (cloud).

examples.japanese: {空|そら}に{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: I saw a contrail in the sky.

examples.japanese: {青空|あおぞら}に{白|しろ}い{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}が{伸|の}びていく。
examples.english: A white contrail stretches across the blue sky.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}が{交差|こうさ}して、{空|そら}に{大|おお}きなバツ{印|じるし}を{描|えが}いた。
examples.english: Two contrails crossed, drawing a big X in the sky.

notes:
Compound of {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane) + {雲|くも} (cloud), with rendaku changing くも to ぐも. Refers to the white vapor trail behind a jet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}ができる: a contrail forms
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}が{伸|の}びる: a contrail stretches out
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}が{消|き}える: a contrail fades away
